name: Oberyn's Clears Tracker
description: Tracks raid and strike clears. Known bugs/issues: 1. Unknown Slothasor API ID for Daily Raid Bounties - will not be registered as a daily cleared bounty. 2. Forging Steel is not tracked by the GW2 API - requires manual click on the strike icon to progress the weekly IBS completion track. Completion state is saved locally and resets with the weekly server reset.

account.details: Required to authenticate the API key.

progression.details: Required to read cleared raid encounters for the week.
